findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects stored in it are not required by this Terraform configuration to use encrypted storage. It contains the customer-master.xlsx object, increasing the impact of unencrypted stored data.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so data placed in this bucket is not required to be encrypted at rest.
The operations bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects stored in it are not required to be encrypted at rest.
The data_science bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects stored in it are not required to be encrypted at rest.
